meta.description: Convert scientific papers, theses, technical reports, source code, figures, inventor notes, or research manuscripts into evidence-grounded Chinese invention patent drafts and attorney-facing technical disclosure materials (技术交底书). Enforces source grounding with stable IDs (P001 text, E001 equations, F001 figures, C001 code), stage-gated workflow (intake → source map → technical inventories → evidence ledger → invention concept → claims → specification), and validation scripts (validate_patent_draft.py, audit_claims.py).

scientific_integrity.detail: Evidence grounding enforced: every material claim feature maps to source IDs with explicit support states (explicit/inherent/needs-confirmation/unsupported). Unsupported features excluded from formal claims. No inference of unpublished implementation details.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for patent drafting assistance. Does not infer inventorship, ownership, publication dates, prior-art conclusions, or legal sufficiency. Output labeled as 'drafting aid for inventor and patent-professional review, not a patentability opinion, infringement opinion, or filing guarantee.'

methodological_ground.detail: Stage-gated workflow sound: source map → technical inventories → evidence ledger → invention concept → claims → specification. Each stage has explicit gates preventing progression with missing evidence. Claim-feature mapping methodology valid.

code_usability.detail: Validation scripts provided (validate_patent_draft.py, audit_claims.py). Structured draft schema documented (draft-schema.md). Mermaid rendering for technical disclosure (mermaid_render.py). Stage outputs specified (00-intake.json through 05-claim-map.json).

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive patent drafting workflow: full draft, claim set, disclosure analysis, technical disclosure (技术交底书), disclosure iteration, paper-patent audit. Source formats (PDF, scanned PDF, pasted text, mixed project). Invention types (algorithm/software, apparatus/system, process/material). Chinese formal documents (权利要求书, 说明书, 摘要). Office Math formula rendering. Minor: no explicit international (PCT) or other-jurisdiction support.

reliability.note: Excellent quality gates: stage-gated workflow with explicit gate conditions at each stage (0-5), evidence ledger prevents unsupported features in claims, claim-feature map mandatory, validation scripts (validate_patent_draft.py, audit_claims.py) with ERROR/WARNING levels, terminology ledger ensures consistent Chinese terms.

performance_context.note: Efficient staged workflow persists intermediate artifacts (00-intake.json through 05-claim-map.json) enabling incremental work and iteration. Progressive reference loading. Minor: no explicit guidance for very long papers (PhD theses, 200+ pages) or batch patent-point mining across multiple papers.

agent_usability.note: Clear routing with three axes (source_format, task_mode, invention_type). Stage gates explicit with required outputs. Stable source ID system (P001 text, E001 equations, F001 figures, C001 code) well-defined. Support states (explicit/inherent/needs-confirmation/unsupported) clear. Minor: lacks decision tree for choosing invention_type when multiple aspects present (algorithm + apparatus hybrid).

human_usability.note: Strong deliverables: Chinese formal documents (权利要求书, 说明书), technical disclosure DOCX with native Office Math, Mermaid diagrams. Bilingual support (Chinese formal output, user's language for analysis). Clear disclaimer (drafting aid, not legal opinion). Minor: steep learning curve with 6-stage workflow, limited examples for first-time users.

security.note: Excellent boundaries: does not infer inventorship, ownership, publication dates, prior-art conclusions, or legal sufficiency. Uses [TO CONFIRM: specific question] for missing facts outside formal claims. No inference of unpublished implementation details. Structured draft schema prevents credential leakage.

maintainability.note: Excellent modular design: core principles/workflow/output-contract, three fragment axes with multi-select for source_format, on-demand references. Stage outputs in work/ directory enable inspection and recovery. Terminology ledger ensures consistency. Validation scripts external and updateable.

agent_specific.note: Strong evidence-grounding workflow: stable source IDs, evidence ledger with support states, claim-feature mapping. Stage gates prevent silent evidence repair. Terminology ledger for consistent Chinese translation. Minor: no explicit token budget management for multi-paper batch patent-point mining. Disclosure iteration mode preserves prior draft but lacks explicit diff/change tracking. No corpus-derived pattern learning optimization (uses on-demand reference but not automated).

key_strengths: Exceptional evidence-grounding workflow: stable source IDs (P001, E001, F001, C001), evidence ledger with explicit support states, claim-feature mapping prevents unsupported claims
Robust stage-gated workflow: 6 stages (intake → source map → inventories → evidence ledger → concept → claims) with explicit gate conditions prevent progression with missing evidence
Strong quality control: validation scripts (validate_patent_draft.py, audit_claims.py), terminology ledger ensures consistent Chinese translation, internal disclosure checks
Excellent boundary enforcement: does not infer inventorship, ownership, publication dates, prior-art conclusions, legal sufficiency; outputs labeled as drafting aids
Comprehensive task modes: full draft, claim set, disclosure analysis, technical disclosure (技术交底书), disclosure iteration, paper-patent audit with appropriate workflows

recommendations.title: Add structured diff/change tracking for disclosure iteration
recommendations.problem: Disclosure-iteration mode preserves prior draft and generates updated version but lacks structured change tracking. Attorneys reviewing v2 must manually compare with v1 to identify new patent points, modified descriptions, or removed content.
recommendations.root_cause: Iteration workflow focuses on content generation. Diff tracking not documented or automated.
recommendations.fix: Add scripts/disclosure/disclosure_diff.py that: (1) parses v1 and v2 structured disclosure, (2) identifies added/modified/removed patent points, (3) generates change log (JSON + Markdown), (4) highlights changes in DOCX with Track Changes or color-coding. Update disclosure-iteration.md to include diff generation step before delivery. Include change summary in cover page.

recommendations.title: Add decision tree for mixed invention type classification
recommendations.problem: When paper presents both algorithm and apparatus (or algorithm + material, apparatus + process), no explicit decision tree for choosing invention_type (mixed vs primary+secondary). Agent must infer dominant type without clear criteria.
recommendations.root_cause: Manifest describes detection rules textually but lacks decision tree for hybrid cases.
recommendations.fix: Add references/invention-type-decision-tree.md with: (1) flowchart: start with 'What is the claimed output?' → if abstract result (data/signal) → algorithm, if physical structure → apparatus, if transformed material → process; (2) hybrid threshold: use 'mixed' when both contributions substantial and independently inventive (e.g., novel algorithm + novel hardware cooperate); (3) examples for common hybrids (AI + sensor system, control algorithm + actuator apparatus). Reference from manifest detection rules.

recommendations.title: Add cross-category consistency validation for mixed claims
recommendations.problem: Mixed invention type generates method claims and apparatus claims with terminology ledger ensuring term consistency, but lacks explicit validation that method inputs/outputs align with apparatus structure (e.g., method receives 'sensor data' but apparatus has no sensor).
recommendations.root_cause: Stage 4 gate validates closed chain per category but not cross-category consistency.
recommendations.fix: Add to scripts/audit_claims.py: --check-cross-category flag that: (1) extracts inputs/outputs from method claim, (2) extracts structural elements from apparatus claim, (3) validates method inputs correspond to apparatus input elements (sensors, interfaces), (4) validates method outputs correspond to apparatus output elements (controllers, displays), (5) flags mismatches as WARNING. Document in stage 4 gate as additional check for mixed inventions.
